description: Conditional rendering block. `@if (value(); as v)` stores the condition result in a local variable.
Loop block with a mandatory `track` expression and implicit variables `$index`, `$count`, `$first`, `$last`, `$even`, `$odd`.
Identity of each item in `@for`. Lets Angular move existing DOM nodes instead of recreating them. Use a stable id.
Optional block after `@for` rendered when the collection is empty.
Renders the first `@case` strictly equal to the expression, or `@default`.
Declares a read-only template variable: `@let total = cart().length;`.
Legacy structural directives replaced by the built-in blocks. Migrate with `ng g @angular/core:control-flow`.
